name: papilio-loader
description: Unified Papilio Loader — one flasher-core + UI, packaged as web static build and Electron desktop app

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/flasher-core && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/flasher-core && npm run test --workspace=apps/desktop
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run serve --workspace=apps/web
